Optimus... 10,000 robots to be built this year

analysis.reasoning: The call was characterized by extreme optimism from Elon Musk regarding long-term value drivers like FSD and Optimus, with highly aggressive forward guidance for 2025-2028. While the CFO provided more grounded data on margin pressure due to lower ASPs and inventory strategies, the overall tone remained overwhelmingly bullish. Innovation momentum is at a peak with specific timelines for unsupervised FSD and humanoid robot production. Risks were mentioned (tariffs, regulatory hurdles in Europe/China) but were secondary to the growth narrative. Quantitative specificity was high regarding CapEx and energy storage targets, though pricing power appears weak due to recent discounting strategies.
